title: Offer
description: A delegation offer, as the STS records it: an agent proposes a narrower grant for one named recipient, which redeems it with its own identity and key to get the child grant. The offering agent fills to, ttl, authorization_details, limits and max_depth; the STS fills the rest from the grant the agent presented.

exp.description: When the offer lapses if nobody redeems it.

parent.description: jti of the offering agent's grant, which becomes the child's parent.

to.description: The only agent that may redeem the offer.

ttl.description: Lifetime of the child grant from redemption, cut short at the parent's exp.

authorization_details.description: What the child grant will allow. Each entry lies within the parent grant.

limits.description: The child's budgets: names from the parent, with a max no higher than the parent's.

max_depth.description: How many further delegation steps the child may take. Absent means none.

redeemed.description: When the recipient redeemed the offer. An offer is redeemed at most once.
